description: Infrastructure Investment Program (project list site and mapping application) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Regional Data Hub and Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts (DITRDCA); publisher not stated. Members: Investment Infrastructure Programs; Infrastructure Investment Program. Example entry: The application shows projects clustered by locations where the Project intersects with selected administrative boundaries. Coverage is Australia, 1996 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as continuous (live), the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-08-23. Files and pages listed: HTML, Report (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
